headline: De Jonghe Residence Restoration / Michel Architects
context: Designed by Lloyd Wright in 1959, the De Jonghe Residence sits in the hills of Los Angeles with a quiet authority. Board-formed concrete, deep overhangs, and a landscape that was always intended to be read as part of the architecture.
